Empower Communities Through Culturally Responsive Social Work

The Master of Social Work (MSW) at Our Lady of the Lake University equips you with the skills, knowledge, and experience to create meaningful change in communities. With a focus on services to Hispanic children and families, this program provides specialized training to advocate for and support diverse populations through evidence-based social work practices.

MSW Services to Hispanic Children and Family (Foundation Program)

This track provides essential coursework in generalist social work practice.

MSW Services to Hispanic Children and Family (Advanced Standing Program)

Tailored for students with a BSW from a CSWE-accredited program.

Mission-Driven Education

Rooted in the Catholic tradition of service, social justice, and advocacy, empowering students to make meaningful contributions to communities.

Hands-On Learning Opportunities

Gain real-world experience through supervised practicums and internships at public and private social service agencies in your local community.

Flexible Program Options

Balance your education with personal and professional commitments through accelerated-track, standard-track, and fully online learning formats.
